Name: DE-Comments
Statement:
select  Oid as CommentsId,
        DocumentTypeName as DocumentType,
        DocumentOid as DocumentId,
        cre.Id as CreatedById,
        cre.Name as CreatedBy,
        cre.HasImage as CreatedByHasImage,
        CreatedOnUtc,
        ModifiedOnUtc,
        Text,
        IsVisibleToClient,
        ActionsJson as Actions,
        ReactionsJson as Reactions,
        HasComments as HasReplies
from    Post cmt
            join UserLookup cre on cre.Id = cmt.CreatedBy
AiToolJson:
{
  "toolName": "de_comments",
  "description": "Returns comments associated with business documents, including their authors, visibility, actions, reactions and reply status. Use when reviewing document discussions, collaboration activity or client-visible comments.",
  "result": {
    "description": "Each row represents a comment associated with a document.",
    "columns": {
      "CommentsId": "Identifies the comment.",
      "DocumentType": "Type of document associated with the comment.",
      "DocumentId": "Identifies the document associated with the comment.",
      "CreatedById": "Identifies the user who created the comment.",
      "CreatedBy": "Name of the user who created the comment.",
      "CreatedByHasImage": "1 if the comment author has a profile image, otherwise 0.",
      "CreatedOnUtc": "UTC date and time when the comment was created.",
      "ModifiedOnUtc": "UTC date and time when the comment was last modified.",
      "Text": "Text content of the comment.",
      "IsVisibleToClient": "1 if the comment is visible to the client, otherwise 0.",
      "Actions": "Action data associated with the comment, represented as JSON.",
      "Reactions": "Reaction data associated with the comment, represented as JSON.",
      "HasReplies": "1 if the comment has replies, otherwise 0."
    }
  },
  "maxRows": 500
}
